features.title: AI Safety & Trust (Overview)
features.description: Ms. Sonoma is designed to be helpful while minimizing mistakes and surprises. In facilitator Help, she uses deterministic app logic when possible instead of relying only on free-form generation for questions about saved settings and learner data.
features.howToUse: If you want a factual readout of saved settings, ask in a 'report' way (e.g., 'show my weekly pattern', 'what are my curriculum preferences'). If you want help understanding a feature, ask in a 'describe' way (e.g., 'what is weekly pattern?').

features.title: Report vs Describe
features.description: Some questions ask for an explanation (describe) and some ask for current saved state (report). In facilitator Help, Ms. Sonoma handles supported report questions by calling existing app APIs so she can answer from authoritative data.
features.howToUse: Use phrasing like 'show my …' or 'what are my …' when you want a readout of saved state. Use 'what is …' or 'how do I …' when you want an explanation.

features.title: Feature Registry (Deterministic Explanations)
features.description: Ms. Sonoma uses a searchable feature registry built from the app's FAQ knowledge base plus report-capable entries to answer facilitator-facing product questions deterministically when possible.
features.howToUse: Ask 'what is …' about a feature such as Syllabus Month View, Lesson Generator, or Goals and Notes. If a product question is not covered, the system may tag it as a blindspot for later review.

features.title: ThoughtHub (Conversation Storage)
features.description: Facilitator Help conversations are stored as account-scoped events so Ms. Sonoma can keep continuity within a conversation and retrieve relevant context from earlier conversations. Learner-specific recall stays scoped to the selected learner, while current Syllabus, Curriculum Guidance, and learning evidence remain authoritative.
features.howToUse: Use the Conversations library to rename or delete saved conversations. Deleting a conversation also removes its active ThoughtHub memory. For account-level access, deletion, or export requests, use the contact listed in the Privacy Policy.

features.title: Blindspots (Missing Feature Coverage)
features.description: When you ask a question that looks like an app-feature question but doesn’t match any known feature entry, the system can tag it as a registry blindspot so it can be reviewed and added later. Personal advice questions should not be tagged as blindspots.
features.howToUse: If Ms. Sonoma can't find a matching feature, try rephrasing with the current UI name, such as 'Syllabus Month View', 'Lesson Generator', or 'Goals and Notes'.
